tasks.title: Verify and Fix Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Review the existing mobile responsive implementation and verify it works correctly across all device sizes:

1. Read and review the responsive CSS files:
   - src/components/Calculator.css (breakpoints: desktop 769px+, tablet 481-768px, mobile 320-480px, extra small <320px)
   - src/components/Button.css (touch targets, WCAG compliance)
   - src/components/Display.css (font scaling, overflow handling)

2. Review the existing visual test script:
   - playwright-visual-test.js (tests mobile 375x667, tablet 768x1024, desktop 1920x1080)

3. Start the dev server and run the visual tests:
   - npm run dev (note the actual port from output)
   - node playwright-visual-test.js

4. Review the generated screenshots in .eunomia/screenshots/qa/ to verify:
   - Calculator fits properly in viewport without horizontal scroll
   - Buttons maintain 44px minimum touch targets
   - Text is readable at all sizes
   - Spacing and layout are appropriate

5. If any issues are found, fix the relevant CSS files

6. Ensure tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx cover responsive behavior (add tests if missing)

7. Stop the dev server when done

Acceptance: All viewports display correctly, no layout issues, screenshots verify proper responsive behavior, tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: Calculator displays correctly on mobile (375x667), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1920x1080)
No horizontal scrolling on any viewport size
Buttons maintain 44px minimum touch targets per WCAG 2.1
Text is readable at all breakpoints
Visual tests run successfully and generate screenshots

tasks.title: Validate Complete Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Run comprehensive validation of the responsive design implementation:

1. Run the unit test suite:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Verify all tests pass, especially Calculator.test.tsx responsive tests

2. Start the dev server:
   - Execute: npm run dev
   - Note the actual port from the output (likely 5173)

3. Run the visual regression tests:
   - Execute: node playwright-visual-test.js
   - Verify it successfully captures screenshots for mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports

4. Review the generated screenshots in .eunomia/screenshots/qa/:
   - calculator-mobile-375x667.png
   - calculator-tablet-768x1024.png
   - calculator-desktop-1920x1080.png
   - Visually verify: proper layout, no overflow, readable text, appropriate spacing

5. Test additional mobile viewports using the .eunomia/screenshot-mobile.js script if it exists

6. Stop the dev server

7. Report any issues found or confirm all validations passed

Acceptance: All tests pass, visual tests complete successfully, screenshots show proper responsive layout on all device sizes.
acceptance_criteria: Visual inspection confirms proper responsive layout
Calculator is functional on all tested device sizes
No horizontal scrolling or layout issues detected
